auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Admin access for the driving school.
auth.footnote: One admin account - the school owner. Students never sign in.

teachers.title: Cars & teachers
teachers.subtitle: Cars are a shared pool - manage them once, then assign each to one or more teachers.
teachers.name: Name
teachers.emptySubtitle: Create the first teacher to start planning weeks.
teachers.carsEmptySubtitle: Add the first car to build the shared pool.

roster.title: Import Roster
roster.subtitle: A CSV file adds new Students and updates existing ones by national ID. It never deactivates anyone.

failureReasons.duplicateNationalId: Duplicate national ID in the file
failureReasons.unknownTeacher: Teacher not found in the system
failureReasons.unknownCar: Car not found in the system
failureReasons.carNotAssignedToTeacher: Car is not assigned to this Teacher

roster.empty: No students yet. Upload the school's CSV to build the roster.

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Students are the people who submit weekly requests. This list includes Students from the Roster and Students added by hand.
students.emptyHint: Add a Student by hand, or import the Roster file.

add.title: Add Student
add.nationalIdInvalid: This national ID isn't valid. Check it has 9 digits and the check digit is right.
add.noCars: This Teacher has no Cars yet. Assign one in Cars & teachers.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.placeholder: Welcome. Planning features arrive in the next slices.

weekSchedules.title: Prepare a week
weekSchedules.subtitle: All slots start Open - click a slot to mark it Unavailable.
weekSchedules.selectTeacherPrompt: Select a teacher and week to prepare the grid.
weekSchedules.notCreatedYet: The Administrator hasn't prepared this week yet.
weekSchedules.loadFailed: Failed to load the week schedule.

publications.title: Publications
publications.subtitle: Publish the week, track requests, and share the link.

shareLink.title: Shareable link
shareLink.hint: One link for all teachers - generated on publish. Share it yourself, e.g. in the students' WhatsApp group.

publications.noPublication: This week has not been prepared yet.

publishDialog.subtitle: One window for the whole school - publish {{week}} and share a single link.

reopenDialog.subtitle: Reopening sets a new close time and lets students edit again. The next close emails a fresh version.

dashboard.draftPrompt: This week is prepared but not published. Publish it to open the submission window and generate the link.
dashboard.draftPromptTeacher: This week is prepared but not published yet. The Administrator publishes it to open the submission window.
dashboard.onlyYours: Only your Publications: what Students requested from you each week.
dashboard.closedNotice: Window closed {{closedAt}}. Excel v{{version}} was emailed to each teacher.

history.title: Publications history
history.subtitle: Every published week, per teacher - with the last emailed Excel version.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Users are the people who can sign in. Each User has one Role.
users.name: Name
users.teacherHintRequired: Required for the Teacher Role. The link can't be changed after creation.
users.teacherHintOptional: Link if this Administrator also teaches. The link can't be changed after creation.
users.teacherRequired: Choose the teacher this User signs in for.
users.temporaryPasswordHint: No email is sent. Give the password to the person yourself.
users.footer: {{count}} Users · Deleted Users are listed last
users.emptyHint: Add Users - Administrators or Teachers - so they can sign in.
users.deleteKeepsTeacher: Their Teacher record, Week Schedules and Publications are not affected.
users.deleteUndo: You can undo this any time with Restore.
users.promoteNote: The link to {{teacher}} is kept. They get access to every screen.
users.demoteNote: From now on they only see {{teacher}}'s Week Schedules and Publications.
users.roleEffect: The change takes effect on their next action, and they'll need to sign in again.
users.temporaryPasswordNote: Their current sessions end immediately. Tell them the new password yourself.
users.temporaryPasswordSelfNote: This is your own password. You're signed out right after saving - sign in again with the new password.

notYetOpen.title: Submissions aren't open yet
notYetOpen.body: The form for week {{weekNumber}} ({{weekRange}}) isn't open yet.
notYetOpen.hint: Come back through the same link - no need for a new one.

closed.title: Submissions are closed
closed.body: The form for week {{weekNumber}} ({{weekRange}}) has closed.
closed.hint: If the school reopens the window, this link will work again.

invalidLink.title: This link isn't valid
invalidLink.body: We couldn't find a form for this link. Ask your school for the current link.

loadFailed.title: Something went wrong
loadFailed.body: We couldn't load the form. Check your connection and try again.

identify.title: Enter your national ID
identify.body: We match it to the school roster to load your details - no password needed.
identify.label: National ID
identify.hint: 9 digits, as registered with the school
identify.foundBody: Let's collect your availability for week {{weekNumber}} with {{teacherName}}.
identify.notOnRosterTitle: We don't have you on file.
identify.notOnRosterBody: This ID isn't on the school's roster, so there's nothing to submit. Please contact your school to be added.
identify.inactiveBody: So you can't submit requests this week. To get back to lessons, contact the school.
identify.inactiveLocked: You can continue only with an active registration
identify.invalidId: This doesn't look like a valid national ID. Check the digits and try again.
identify.failed: We couldn't check your ID right now. Check your connection and try again.
identify.welcomeBackBodyOne: You already sent 1 pick on {{savedAt}}, so we've loaded it. You can edit your submission until the window closes ({{closesAt}}).
identify.welcomeBackBodyMany: You already sent {{pickCount}} picks on {{savedAt}}, so we've loaded them. You can edit your submission until the window closes ({{closesAt}}).

details.noAvailabilityBody: {{teacherName}} hasn't published availability for this week. Please contact your school.

target.title: How many lessons do you want this week?
target.body: You'll then pick at least that many slots, ranked by preference.

slots.title: Pick your slots, best first
slots.body: Tap a slot to add it - the order is your preference. Tap a picked slot to change or remove it. Striped slots are unavailable.

pick.constraintHint: Free text - e.g. "only after 16:00", "pick me up from work"

review.title: Your ranked list
review.preferredOne: Rank 1 is your preferred slot; any others are backups.
review.preferredMany: Ranks 1-{{target}} are your preferred slots; the rest are backups.
review.notEnoughBody: Your target is {{target}}, but you've picked {{picked}}. Add {{missing}} more, or lower your target.
review.replaces: You already sent a list for this week. Submitting now replaces it.
review.droppedOne: 1 of your earlier picks is no longer offered this week, so we took it off your list.
review.droppedMany: {{count}} of your earlier picks are no longer offered this week, so we took them off your list.
review.unlockHint: Submit unlocks once you have {{target}} picks.
review.reorderHint: Drag a pick by its handle, or use the arrows, to change its rank.

errors.rejected: We couldn't save your list - something changed since you opened the form, for example a slot is no longer available.
errors.notFound: We couldn't find your roster details or this week's slots anymore. Please contact your school.
errors.failed: We couldn't send your list. Check your connection and try again.

submitted.title: Submitted
submitted.bodyOne: 1 pick for week {{weekNumber}} with {{teacherName}}. You can edit it until {{closesAt}} - just reopen this link and enter your national ID.
submitted.bodyMany: {{count}} picks for week {{weekNumber}} with {{teacherName}}. You can edit them until {{closesAt}} - just reopen this link and enter your national ID.

closedMidSubmit.title: The window just closed
closedMidSubmit.bodyNew: Submissions for week {{weekNumber}} closed while you had this page open. Your list was not saved. If it's urgent, contact {{teacherName}} directly.
closedMidSubmit.bodyChanges: Submissions for week {{weekNumber}} closed while you had this page open. Your changes were not saved - the list you sent earlier stays as it was. If it's urgent, contact {{teacherName}} directly.
closedMidSubmit.hint: If the school reopens the window, this link will work again.

access.refusedTitle: You don't have access to that page
access.refusedDetail: We've taken you to your Week Schedule.
